contributions.statement: If an agent must select from thousands of tools, retrieve jointly coherent tool sets rather than independently ranked tools.
contributions.evidence: Table 2 (3 seeds): removing set scoring drops COMP@5 77.6 to 67.4 and pass rate 69.7 to 58.0; ToolBench with a 7B agent only.

reason: Sound ablation, but it only applies to catalogs of thousands of APIs with co-invocation training data; this harness keeps a small catalog and only considers tool retrieval above ~10-15 tools.
